title: Worker report for the UI card (Ivan's order 2026-09-15 23:11 WITA)
description: Short, itemised: what was done (with links), where to look at the result, and the login/password when the result needs a sign-in. Written by the worker to artifacts/<task id>/report.json; validated by ui/report-validate.mjs (tests: ui/report.test.mjs); rendered first in the task card summary.

items.description: https:// URL, file:// URL, absolute path, or a path relative to the mission dir (artifacts/…)

path.description: file:// URL, absolute path, or path relative to the mission dir

access.description: sign-in for each result that needs it. Test stands: login + password in the clear. Live host: secretRef (where the secret lives) instead of the password — secrets never enter git.

secretRef.description: path or name of the place holding the password, e.g. /opt/upready-store/mt/deploy/mt/shipshift.env

notes.description: open nits, decisions handed to Ivan
